raw_response:
1. SELECT a.asset_name  
   FROM assets a  
   JOIN grid_topology gt ON gt.downstream_asset_id = a.asset_id  
   JOIN assets upstream ON upstream.asset_id = gt.upstream_asset_id  
   WHERE upstream.asset_name = 'BR-004'  
   ORDER BY a.asset_name;

2. SELECT a.asset_name  
   FROM grid_topology gt  
   JOIN assets a ON a.asset_id = gt.downstream_asset_id  
   WHERE gt.upstream_asset_id = (SELECT asset_id FROM assets WHERE asset_name = 'BR-004')  
   ORDER BY a.asset_name;

3. SELECT a.asset_name  
   FROM assets a  
   WHERE a.asset_id IN (  
       SELECT gt.downstream_asset_id  
       FROM grid_topology gt  
       JOIN assets up ON up.asset_id = gt.upstream_asset_id  
       WHERE up.asset_name = 'BR-004'  
   )  
   ORDER BY a.asset_name;
